prompt: Create a full-body minimalist studio portrait of a young woman with long wavy brown hair in a high ponytail, warm medium skin tone, hoop earrings, a black T-shirt, olive cargo pants, and black-and-white sneakers jumping energetically in midair against a clean off-white studio wall and pale concrete floor. Show a precise vertical split down the center of the body: the left half is realistic color photography with natural soft window light, visible fabric texture, realistic hair movement, and a raised left fist; the right half is transformed into a black-and-white hand-drawn manga/comic sketch version of the same pose, matching the identity, clothing, proportions, hair, and motion exactly. The character’s legs are bent as if leaping, one sneaker kicked back on the photo side and the other descending on the sketch side. Add exactly 14 comic-style drawn background elements only on the sketch side: 3 outlined stars, 2 cartoon smoke clouds, 2 lightning-bolt marks, 5 long speed-line clusters, 1 impact burst at the floor under the foot, and 1 group of small ink dots. Keep the background minimal and uncluttered, with the split line perfectly aligned through the face, torso, pants, and shoes. Use high-resolution editorial lighting, playful action energy, crisp realism on the left, expressive ink hatching on the right, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一张全身极简主义摄影棚肖像，画面主体为 一位扎着高马尾、留着棕色长卷发、肤色温暖、佩戴圆环耳饰、身穿黑色 T 恤、橄榄色工装裤并脚踩黑白运动鞋的年轻女性 在干净的米白色摄影棚墙壁和浅色水泥地面背景前充满活力地跳跃。画面需在身体中心进行精确的垂直分割：左半部分为写实彩色摄影，呈现自然柔和的窗光、清晰的织物纹理、逼真的发丝动态以及高举的左拳；右半部分则转化为与左侧姿势完全一致的黑白手绘漫画/连环画素描版本，确保身份、服装、比例、发型和动作精准匹配。角色双腿弯曲呈跳跃状，左侧照片中一只运动鞋向后踢起，右侧素描中另一只脚向下落。仅在素描一侧添加 14 个漫画风格的背景元素：3 个轮廓星形、2 朵卡通烟雾云、2 个闪电标记、5 组长速线、1 个脚下地面的冲击爆破效果以及 1 组小墨点。保持背景极简且整洁，分割线需完美穿过脸部、躯干、裤子和鞋子。采用高分辨率的编辑级布光，展现俏皮的动作张力，左侧保持清晰的写实感，右侧呈现富有表现力的墨水排线，画面无文字、无水印、无多余人物。
